correctness.rationale: At line-graph vertex ij, total neighbors=2(n-2); if edge ij is one, its one-neighbors=d_i+d_j-2, so fixedness requires d_i+d_j>=n; if zero, requires d_i+d_j<=n-2. The excluded sum n-1 makes the one-edge set a self-degree threshold graph. Canonical threshold creation bits yield degrees d_i=i b_i+sum_{j>i} b_j; the pairwise inequality is necessary and sufficient. Terminal degree-twin classes give the correct orbit weight n!/prod m_r!. The sparse-case turn inequalities on height h=n-2k, bijective removal of h-2 initial zeros, two-child recursion and complement symmetry yield u_{n,k}=2^(k-1) in sparse regime, absence of odd middle class, total 2^floor(n/2). Independent direct majority enumeration over all 2^C(n,2) edge states for n=3,4,5,6 gives labelled fixed counts 2,10,12,164 and relabelling orbits 2,4,4,8; checked original verify.py and brute.cpp. These are finite diagnostics of the all-size proof.
